arxiv-2011-14210.title: Insulated primes
arxiv-2011-14210.creator: Abhimanyu Kumar, Anuraag Saxena
arxiv-2011-14210.description: Abstract . The degree of insulation of a prime p p is defined as the largest interval around it in which no other prime exists. Based on this, the n n -th prime p n p_{n} is said to be insulated if and only if its degree of insulation is higher than its neighboring primes.

arxiv-2109-12786.title: Self-Replicating Neural Programs
arxiv-2109-12786.creator: Samuel Schmidgall
arxiv-2109-12786.description: Abstract In this work, a neural network is trained to replicate the code that trains it using only its own output as input. A paradigm for evolutionary self-replication in neural programs is introduced, where program parameters are mutated, and the ability for the program to more efficiently train itself leads to greater reproductive success.

arxiv-2311-13119.title: Quantum optimization of coherent chaotic systems: A case for buses of Kathmandu.
arxiv-2311-13119.creator: Kiran Adhikari, Christian Deppe, Aman Ganeju, Iva Kumari Lamichhane, Rohit Bhattarai, Manghang Limbu, Nishma Bhattarai
arxiv-2311-13119.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel quantum computing approach to solve the real-world problem of optimizing transportation in bustling Kathmandu city. The transportation system in Kathmandu is chaotic, with no central authority controlling the transportation. We leverage this chaotic feature in our quantum optimization procedure.

arxiv-2405-08524.title: The Asymptotic Properties of the Extreme Eigenvectors of High-dimensional Generalized Spiked Covariance Model
arxiv-2405-08524.creator: F.Zhangni Pu, S.Xiaozhuo Zhang, T.Jiang Hu, F.Zhidong Bai
arxiv-2405-08524.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the asymptotic behaviors of the extreme eigenvectors in a general spiked covariance matrix, where the dimension and sample size increase proportionally. We eliminate the restrictive assumption of the block diagonal structure in the population covariance matrix. Moreover, there is no requirement for the spiked eigenvalues and the 4th moment to be bounded.

arxiv-2410-16309.title: In-the-loop Hyper-Parameter Optimization for LLM-Based Automated Design of Heuristics
arxiv-2410-16309.creator: Niki van Stein, Diederick Vermetten, Thomas Bäck
arxiv-2410-16309.description: Abstract . Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential in automatically generating and optimizing (meta)heuristics, making them valuable tools in heuristic optimization tasks. However, LLMs are generally inefficient when it comes to fine-tuning hyper-parameters of the generated algorithms, often requiring excessive queries that lead to high computational and financial costs.

pmc-10715940.title: From escalation to weaning strategies: how to integrate the ECMELLA concept
pmc-10715940.creator: Benedikt Schrage, Alexander Bernhardt, Evgenij Potapov, Letizia F Bertoldi, Norman Mangner
pmc-10715940.description: The additional implantation of a micro-axial flow pump (mAFP) in patients receiving extracorporeal life support by a veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (V-A ECMO) for cardiogenic shock (CS) has gained interest in recent years. Thus far, retrospective propensity score-matched studies, case series, and meta-analyses have consistently shown an improved survival in patients treated with the so-called ECMELLA concept.

pmc-11291924.title: Mesenchymal stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles ameliorate renal interstitial fibrosis via the miR-13474/ADAM17 axis
pmc-11291924.creator: Linru Shi, Yuyan Hu, Houcheng Zeng, Hui Shi, Wenrong Xu, Yaoxiang Sun, Hong Chu, Cheng Ji, Hui Qian
pmc-11291924.description: Renal interstitial fibrosis (RIF) is a prevalent consequence of chronic renal diseases, characterized by excessive extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition. A Disintegrin and Metalloprotease 17 (ADAM17), a transmembrane metalloproteinase, plays a central role in driving renal fibrosis progression by activating Notch 1 protein and the downstream TGF-β signaling pathway.

pmc-11713688.title: Exploring cortical perivascular space as a biomarker in neurodegenerative diseases through optimized CSF‐only MRI at 7T
pmc-11713688.creator: Zeynep Demir, Gael Saib, Lalith Talagala, Paul Taylor, Justin Y Kwan, Alan Koretsky
pmc-11713688.description: BackgroundDetecting changes in perivascular spaces (PVS) holds promise as a biomarker for neurodegenerative diseases. These spaces exhibit increased protein accumulation and dilatation in neurodegenerative diseases even preceding symptomatic stages. Advanced MRI techniques at high fields offer unparalleled clarity in visualizing these subtle structures.

pmc-12745143.title: The role of diagnostic laparoscopy in staging distal esophageal adenocarcinoma
pmc-12745143.creator: Stella T. Tsui, Nanruoyi Zhou, Kay See Tan, Junting Zheng, Katherine D. Gray, Smita Sihag, Valerie W. Rusch, Manjit S. Bains, Bernard J. Park, Matthew J. Bott, James Huang, Prasad S. Adusumilli, Laura H. Tang, Daniela Molena, David R. Jones
pmc-12745143.description: ObjectivesThe study objectives were to determine whether diagnostic laparoscopy improves staging accuracy in selected patients with distal esophageal adenocarcinoma and to identify clinicopathologic features associated with positive diagnostic laparoscopy.MethodsPatients with distal esophageal adenocarcinoma who underwent diagnostic laparoscopy from 2000 to 2023 at a single institution were identified from a prospectively maintained surgical database.

pmc-13124893.title: Factors associated with central venous port implantation during breast cancer perioperative chemotherapy: a Japanese database study
pmc-13124893.creator: Mari Abe, Kojiro Morita, Takaaki Konishi, Katsuhiko Nara, Yuya Kimura, Kiyohide Fushimi, Hideo Yasunaga, Gojiro Nakagami
pmc-13124893.description: BackgroundVascular access guidelines in Western countries recommend the central venous (CV) administration of cytotoxic chemotherapy agents to reduce complications such as extravasation. However, in Japan, peripheral venous administration is common. This study aimed to clarify the current status of using CV ports in Japan and its associated patient and institutional factors in breast cancer cases.

pmc-13218608.creator: Rafael Loch Batista
pmc-13218608.description: genitalia. Ultrasonography shows no uterus. Hormone levels and, later, the karyotype will point us to a diagnosis I know well: complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS). The lab work is the easy part. I am an endocrinologist, trained to assemble “sex” from pieces: chromosomes, gonads, hormones, receptors. Most days this feels precise, almost mechanical.

pmc-13226887.title: Transglutaminase-mediated glycosylation improves the physicochemical properties and in vitro hypolipidemic activity of oyster peptides
pmc-13226887.creator: Qianqian Huang, Zhongqin Chen, Mingtang Tan, Huina Zheng, Haisheng Lin, Jialong Gao, Xiaoming Qin, Wenhong Cao
pmc-13226887.description: Oyster peptides exhibit diverse bioactivities but suffer from poor stability and digestive degradation, limiting functional food applications. To overcome these, this study employed transglutaminase (TGase)-catalyzed glycosylation to conjugate glucosamine (GlcN) with an oyster peptide ultrafiltration fraction (UF3), and evaluated the structural, physicochemical, and hypolipidemic properties.

pmc-13231865.title: Rising Black life expectancy in an era of increased immigration
pmc-13231865.creator: Arun S Hendi, Veronica Clevenstine
pmc-13231865.description: Though American mortality conditions have deteriorated in recent years, one bright spot has been Black life expectancy. Between 1994 and 2019, Black life expectancy rose by 5 years for women and 7 years for men, with most of these gains attributed to improving social and economic conditions for Black Americans.

pmc-13424995.title: Risk-benefit considerations for antirheumatic drug use in pregnancy, breastfeeding, and male preconception: expert perspectives
pmc-13424995.creator: Andrea Pluma, Linda Rüegg, Sabrina Hamroun, Irene Cecchi, Axel Finckh, Yvette Meissner, Frauke Förger
pmc-13424995.description: ObjectivesManaging antirheumatic drug therapy during family planning, pregnancy, and breastfeeding remains challenging in rheumatology. Since inactive rheumatic disease is an important prerequisite for favourable fertility and pregnancy outcomes, clinicians must weigh the risk of drug exposure against the risk of uncontrolled disease. This study explored how considerations of disease activity influence prescribing decisions.

pmc-13566077.title: Clinicians’ Attitudes and Perceptions on the Adoption of AI in Mental Health Care: Scoping Review
pmc-13566077.creator: Carly Hudson, Thuy Linh Phan, Marcus Randall
pmc-13566077.description: BackgroundAI is increasingly being integrated into health care workflows, with growing interest in AI systems for documentation, screening, triage, monitoring, and decision support. Mental health care is particularly complex for AI implementation as clinical care largely depends on therapeutic relationships, contextual factors, empathic communication, and interpretation of subtle nonverbal cues.

pmc-13590090.title: Pelvic vein embolization using different embolic agents for the treatment of pelvic venous insufficiency: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13590090.creator: Felix Strobl, Agnes Klara Böhm, Lorenz Mertens, Maximilian de Bucourt, Jan Paul Frese, Houman Jalaie, Andreas Greiner, Leon Bruder
pmc-13590090.description: ObjectiveEmbolization of insufficient pelvic veins has been established as the standard first-line therapy in women with chronic pain due to pelvic venous disorder; however, the clinically available embolic devices vary widely, with coils, vascular plugs, glue, and sclerosants or combinations of these devices being the most common.
